staff_novelty_composite.rationale: No new HC (Carroll returning for Y13), no new OC (Waldron returning for Y2), no new GM (John Schneider continuous since 2010). New DC Clint Hurtt was an internal promotion from the existing staff, not an external hire.

SEA:2022.extraction_notes: Pete Carroll was a multi-time NFL HC retread (Jets 1994, Patriots 1997-99, USC 2001-09) so hc_first_time_flag=false and hc_background_tag=college (came from USC). Waldron's McVay-tree pedigree (Rams passing game coordinator 2018-20) drives the shanahan scheme tag; the 2022 Seattle offense featured play-action, outside zone, bootlegs. New DC Clint Hurtt was an internal promotion (on staff since 2017 as DL coach/AHC), not counted as a new external staff hire for novelty_composite purposes. GM John Schneider has been continuous since Jan 2010, no change in 2022 offseason. staff_novelty_composite = 0.

scheme_tag.rationale: Kyle Shanahan IS the originator of the Shanahan/outside-zone wide-zone tree; the 49ers run the prototype version of this system with play-action off bootleg, outside zone run game, and 11/12 personnel sets.

hc_id.rationale: PFR 2022 49ers page lists 'Coach: Kyle Shanahan (13-4-0)' and the 49ers.com 2022 roster breakdown confirms 2022 was Shanahan's sixth season as HC.

hc_first_time_flag.rationale: Shanahan became HC of the 49ers on February 6, 2017. his first NFL HC role. so by 2022 he was a six-year veteran head coach, not a first-timer.

hc_tenure_yrs.rationale: Shanahan was hired before the 2017 season; 2017=Y1, 2018=Y2, 2019=Y3, 2020=Y4, 2021=Y5, 2022=Y6.

hc_background_tag.rationale: Immediately before becoming 49ers HC in 2017, Shanahan was the offensive coordinator of the Atlanta Falcons (2015-16), leading that offense to Super Bowl LI.

oc_id.rationale: No OC was named entering 2022. Mike McDaniel departed to become Dolphins HC, and Shanahan retained play-calling duties himself. PFR 2022 page lists no offensive coordinator, only separate run-game (Foerster) and pass-game (Slowik) coordinators. Per coding rules, HC slug is used when HC calls plays with no named OC.

oc_tenure_yrs.rationale: Shanahan has been the de-facto play-caller since arriving in 2017; the OC-by-committee structure existed throughout his tenure, making this effectively Year 6 of Shanahan as the offensive play-caller.

oc_first_year_with_team_flag.rationale: Shanahan (the play-caller / de-facto OC) was in Year 6 with the team entering 2022; he was not new to this team.

staff_novelty_composite.rationale: No new HC (Shanahan returning, Year 6), no externally-hired OC (role absorbed by sitting HC Shanahan; no new person installed), no new GM (John Lynch returning, also Year 6 with team). Count of {new HC, new OC, new GM} = 0.

SF:2022.extraction_notes: OC BY COMMITTEE / HC AS PLAY-CALLER: The 49ers entered 2022 with no named offensive coordinator after Mike McDaniel departed to become Miami's HC. Kyle Shanahan retained play-calling duties, with Chris Foerster as Run Game Coordinator and Bobby Slowik as Passing Game Coordinator serving as position-specific coordinators beneath him. Per coding rules, oc_id is set to 'kyle-shanahan' and oc_first_year_with_team_flag is false (Shanahan Year 6). This is consistent with the 49ers' historical structure. they had no OC from 2017-2020, briefly named McDaniel OC in 2021, then reverted to no named OC in 2022. staff_novelty_composite=0: Lynch (GM, since 2017) and Shanahan (HC, since 2017) both returning; no external OC hire made. The 2022 coaching staff announcement (49ers.com) listed Bobby Slowik with a new title ('Passing Game Coordinator') and Klay Kubiak with a new title ('Asst. Quarterbacks'), but neither was a new GM or OC hire.

hc_first_time_flag.rationale: Bowles previously served as HC of the New York Jets from 2015–2018; 2022 is his second NFL HC stint.

hc_tenure_yrs.rationale: Bowles was hired as Buccaneers HC in the 2022 offseason (March 30, 2022), making 2022 Year 1.

hc_background_tag.rationale: Bowles served as Tampa Bay's defensive coordinator from 2019–2021 immediately before being promoted to HC in March 2022.

oc_id.rationale: Leftwich was confirmed as returning OC for 2022, retained by new HC Bowles; he held the role from 2019–2022.

oc_tenure_yrs.rationale: Leftwich was hired as Buccaneers OC in January 2019 (Year 1=2019, Year 2=2020, Year 3=2021, Year 4=2022).

oc_first_year_with_team_flag.rationale: Leftwich had been the Buccaneers OC since 2019; 2022 was his fourth season with the team.

staff_novelty_composite.rationale: Only the HC role was new in the 2022 offseason (Bowles promoted March 2022); OC Leftwich and GM Jason Licht were both retained incumbents.

scheme_tag.rationale: Pro-Football-Reference's 2022 TEN team page explicitly labels the offensive scheme as 'West Coast'; the Titans ran a physical run-first attack with West Coast pass concepts under Downing/Vrabel.

hc_id.rationale: PFR 2022 TEN page lists Coach: Mike Vrabel (7-10-0); multiple sources confirm he was HC entering the 2022 season.

hc_first_time_flag.rationale: Vrabel was first hired as HC in January 2018; 2022 was his fifth season as an NFL head coach, not his first time ever.

hc_background_tag.rationale: Immediately before becoming Titans HC, Vrabel was the Houston Texans' defensive coordinator in 2017.

oc_id.rationale: PFR 2022 TEN page lists Offensive Coordinator: Todd Downing; confirmed by multiple sources.

oc_tenure_yrs.rationale: Downing was promoted to OC on January 29, 2021 (Y1=2021, Y2=2022); he was fired after the 2022 season.

oc_first_year_with_team_flag.rationale: Downing joined the Titans as tight ends coach in January 2019 and was promoted internally to OC in 2021; he was not new to the team in 2022.

staff_novelty_composite.rationale: Entering 2022, there was no new HC (Vrabel returning Year 5), no new OC (Downing returning Year 2), and no new GM (Jon Robinson was the incumbent GM through December 6, 2022).

TEN:2022.extraction_notes: All fields are coded as of the start of the 2022 season (entering Week 1). HC Mike Vrabel was in his 5th season; OC Todd Downing was in his 2nd season as OC (promoted internally from TE coach in Jan 2021); GM Jon Robinson was the incumbent GM (not fired until December 6, 2022, mid-season). No new HC, OC, or GM were hired in the 2022 offseason, yielding a staff_novelty_composite of 0. PFR labels the offensive scheme 'West Coast,' consistent with the Titans' balanced run-heavy/West Coast pass system under Vrabel/Downing. hc_first_time_flag is false because Vrabel had been an NFL HC since 2018.

scheme_tag.rationale: Pro-Football-Reference labels the 2022 WAS offense 'Air Coryell'; Scott Turner ran a vertical-passing, pro-style system rooted in the Norv Turner lineage. not a Shanahan/McVay outside zone, Reid west-coast, or air-raid tree.

hc_id.rationale: Pro-Football-Reference 2022 WAS page lists Ron Rivera as head coach with an 8-8-1 record.

hc_first_time_flag.rationale: Rivera was first hired as an NFL head coach by the Carolina Panthers in January 2011; Washington in 2020 was his second head-coaching job.

hc_tenure_yrs.rationale: Rivera was hired before the 2020 season (Year 1 = 2020, Year 2 = 2021, Year 3 = 2022).

hc_background_tag.rationale: Rivera came from a prior NFL HC seat (Carolina Panthers 2011-2019, fired mid-2019); he is a retread HC, not a first-time HC from a coordinator or college role.

oc_id.rationale: Pro-Football-Reference 2022 WAS page lists Scott Turner as offensive coordinator; he signed a new 3-year deal in March 2022 and was not fired until after the 2022 season concluded.

oc_tenure_yrs.rationale: Turner was hired by Washington when Rivera was hired before the 2020 season (Year 1=2020, Year 2=2021, Year 3=2022).

oc_first_year_with_team_flag.rationale: Turner joined Washington in 2020 and was entering his third year with the team in 2022; he re-signed on a new deal in March 2022 but had not changed teams.

staff_novelty_composite.rationale: No new HC (Rivera entering Year 3), no new OC (Turner re-signed to same role entering Year 3), and no new GM (Martin Mayhew was hired before the 2021 season and remained in 2022).

WAS:2022.extraction_notes: PFR labels Washington's 2022 offensive scheme 'Air Coryell'. mapped to pro_style in our taxonomy as it is a traditional vertical-passing, dropback pro-style system under Scott Turner (son of Norv Turner), not fitting any of the named coaching-tree tags (Shanahan, McVay, Reid, air_raid, west_coast, erhardt_perkins). Rivera is a retread HC (prior Panthers job 2011-2019), so hc_background_tag='other'. Martin Mayhew remained GM for the full 2022 season (ESPN confirmed him in March 2022); he was not replaced until January 2024 under new ownership. No staff changes entering 2022. Rivera (Year 3), Turner (Year 3), Mayhew (Year 2) all carried over. staff_novelty_composite=0.
